text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One afternoon, while getting ready for training with <chrname>…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock!
Excuse me? Are you Trainer <username>?
choice_data_list: Um… May I ask your name?

text_block_list.text: I'm terribly sorry. I should have introduced myself. I'm a reporter for Twinkle Monthly.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: My name is Etsuko Otonashi.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I was looking for trainers to write about, and Director Akikawa mentioned your name specifically.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best not to interfere with your training. I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is the first I'm hearing of any interview, but Otonashi's polite and sincere attitude puts me at ease.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Thank you for agreeing to take part.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Let's get into it, shall we? As I'm sure you're aware, the launch of the URA Finale has taken the racing world by storm.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Could you tell us how that's affected you and your trainee's outlook?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's true that there have been big changes, but ever since the day I decided to walk with <chrname>, my convictions have always stayed the same.
choice_data_list: I will keep supporting her so she can achieve her dreams.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I see. In other words, you consider your role as a trainer to be…
choice_data_list: To help my Umamusume achieve her dreams!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Th-that's…

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: That's simply… simply…

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: SIMPLY AMAZING!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: To help your trainee Umamusume achieve her dreams! That's what you said, no?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Then I'm sure you must be willing to take on any burden with a smile!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Training wherever and whenever she asks! Taking her on hot spring tours to recover from races! Venturing to remote mountain streams just to fetch her a cup of water!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Ah… What devotion… I'm so moved!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Splendid! I see the interview has started!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: What do you think? Quite the talented trainer, no?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Absolutely! This is only our first meeting, but I've been practically moved to tears!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: It takes a special trainer to be willing to plunge into a hurricane for their trainee!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Wonderful! That's a prospective star Umamusume's trainer for you!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I've been keeping a close eye on your recent activities!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: But hmmm… How strange! It seems like you're having trouble gaining fans.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Worry not! There's still time before the URA Finale! I'm sure you can turn things around!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: You're receiving a fair bit of support as well! With a performance as compelling as yours, I knew you'd win hearts!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Anticipation! Make the best of every race that comes your way and show us some great results!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Astonishing! You're also receiving more support than I could ever have imagined!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: With a trainee as captivating as yours, a spot in the URA Finale is no mere fantasy!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: A star Umamusume is measured by the amount of support she has. That's how you can tell she is loved.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I would also like to help you gather more support.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Gratitude! The media's assistance will be essential, both for boosting the popularity of our Umamusume and for ensuring the event succeeds!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you, Miss Otonashi! Help us make the URA Finale a success!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Of course. Thank you very much for your time, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sense that I've met a powerful ally in the fight to increase <chrname>'s support…
